capabilities: Search PubMed and add papers by DOI, PMID, arXiv or title
Write AI section summaries and MeSH topic tags into reference notes
Insert [@citekey] citations and build CSL-styled bibliographies
Search and chat over the library with citation-grounded answers
Run systematic-review screening, PRISMA diagrams and risk-of-bias tables
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.11.4+); a contact e-mail must be set in settings for OpenAlex, Unpaywall and PubMed lookups; API keys are kept in the OS keychain; MCP vault access is opt-in and its note-editing tools can be switched off.
intentEvidence: a Zotero / EndNote replacement inside Obsidian
motivation: The author wanted the reference library to stay portable and owned by the user, with no external app, account or backend.
problem: Reference managers such as Zotero and EndNote keep the library in a separate app, so citations, summaries and notes sit apart from the vault.
